items.name: NÖ Cube Day 2023

venue.name: Veranstaltungszentrum Z2000
venue.details: Veranstaltungszentrum Stockerau, 2nd floor, follow the signs

items.information:
English version is below
Deutsch:
Wir freuen uns sehr euch NÖ Cube Day 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner, Dieter Amberger, Pranjal Khan, David Dinh und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar. Das Turnier findet im Veranstaltungszentrum Z2000 statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

English:
We are happy to announce the NÖ Cube Day 2023 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner, Dieter Amberger, Pranjal Khan, David Dinh and is delegated by Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

venue.address: 2407 Ave C North, Saskatoon, SK S7L 6T1

items.information:
We ask attendees to limit themselves to one guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 200 people.
Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time.
Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in.

First Time Competitors: 
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://youtu.be/xK2ycvTfgUY) for the basic overview of the rules.

Judging:
All competitors are expected to help at this competition. We will have a judging tutorial at the beginning of the day. All competitors will be assigned to judge 1 group of each of the events they are competing in. There will also be tickets for raffle prizes given for every round a competitor judges.

items.information:
東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ(以下 TSC)は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」を定期的に開催しており、2023年9月に100回目の開催を迎えます。これを記念し、第100回TSCスペース記念大会を開催します。
今大会は受付時間を設けておりません。参加される競技に合わせてお越しください。競技の進行によっては時間を前倒しで進めますので余裕をもってお越しください。

今大会終了後に第100回TSCスペースを開催します。詳細は[第100回TSCスペース記念サイト](https://100th.cubing.nagoya/)をご覧ください。

Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as TSC) has been holding off-line meetings for speedcubers called "TSC Space" on a regular basis and will celebrate its 100th meeting in September 2023. To commemorate this event, The 100th TSC Space Memorial competition will be held.
No check-in is required at the competition day. Please come according to the competition you will be participating in. Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be ahead of schedule, so please ensure to arrive in plenty of time.

The 100th TSC Space will be held after this competition. For more information, please visit [the 100th TSC Space Commemorative Website](https://100th.cubing.nagoya/).

items.information:
* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
